allow: PowerShell(if \($env:TRAKT_CLIENT_ID\) { "TRAKT_CLIENT_ID set: $\($env:TRAKT_CLIENT_ID.Length\) chars" } else { "TRAKT_CLIENT_ID MISSING" }; if \($env:TRAKT_CLIENT_SECRET\) { "TRAKT_CLIENT_SECRET set" } else { "TRAKT_CLIENT_SECRET MISSING" })

PowerShell($p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if \($p\) { $p | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; Write-Output "Killed PID $_" } } else { Write-Output "Nothing on port 3000" })
